subject.title: fix(agents): preserve thinking default precedence for listed agents

question: Should `resolveAgentThinkingDefaultOverride()` become a supported public plugin SDK API, or should precedence provenance remain internal to bundled runtime consumers?
rationale: The new export is an external compatibility surface; repository policy treats plugin API additions as requiring maintainer-visible direction rather than assuming that a bundled Telegram caller defines the permanent external contract.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Replace the public SDK export with a bundled-only/internal seam so external plugins do not inherit a narrowly scoped precedence API.

options.title: Approve a stable SDK helper
options.body: Retain the export, document its explicit-only semantics and intended callers, and add focused compatibility coverage before treating it as supported.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal
recommendation.body: Replace the public SDK export with a bundled-only/internal seam so external plugins do not inherit a narrowly scoped precedence API.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged ingress work is the closest established ownership signal for per-agent thinking-default precedence.
